text: The medical pause is a theoretical framework describing how brief interruptions in clinical activities can optimize cognitive load through reflection and relaxation. However, little is known about what occurs during instructor-prompted and learner-led pauses in simulation-based training. This study investigates whether reflection or relaxation predominates during the specific pauses and how these activities influence cognitive load and performance.
source_label: Learners’ perceptions of the medical pause: cognitive load and team performance
